title_zh: 京张接单｜十二张场景单
title_en: Jingzhang Takes the Call | Twelve Scene Orders

scene_orders.problem: A route obstruction or misleading connection prevents an independently usable journey.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Field walk, telephone report and manual inspection.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Issue description and coarse location only; no continuous individual trajectory.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Paper map, fixed high-contrast or tactile direction and staff confirmation.
scene_orders.human_gate: Accessibility users and qualified reviewers confirm the issue and repair.
scene_orders.acceptance: An independently usable route is confirmed in a field walk.
scene_orders.exit: Remove or disable digital guidance if it misroutes; fixed non-digital guidance remains.

scene_orders.problem: Duplicate or incomplete maintenance reports are not assigned and followed through.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Telephone, in-person report and existing work-order channel.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Facility type, coarse location, time and public description; reporter identity optional.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Existing work-order and staffed service desk.
scene_orders.human_gate: Maintenance owner verifies classification, repair and closure.
scene_orders.acceptance: Repair or reasoned transfer is confirmed and the reporter can check status.
scene_orders.exit: Return to the ordinary work-order process if triage cannot sustain follow-up.

scene_orders.problem: People cannot identify the right official or professional channel for a service request.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Staffed consultation, telephone and printed guide.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Question and chosen language; no passport, health, immigration or employment data in the public intake layer.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Printed multilingual directory and staffed interpretation/referral.
scene_orders.human_gate: A service professional confirms the route and any high-risk response.
scene_orders.acceptance: The person reaches an appropriate human or official channel without repeating unnecessary data.
scene_orders.exit: Disable automated routing for any high-risk or repeatedly incorrect category.

scene_orders.problem: Research capability and real urban need cannot be translated into a bounded, testable brief.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Public problem framing first; confidential IP and data remain in authorized professional channels.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Human case-manager interview and written scene-order template.
scene_orders.human_gate: Case manager signs IP, ethics, data, responsibility and next-step status.
scene_orders.acceptance: The brief contains all fourteen required fields or receives a reasoned referral/closure.
scene_orders.exit: Close or refer if no owner, lawful data route, non-AI comparator or test boundary exists.

scene_orders.title_zh: 开源项目首个城市用户日
scene_orders.problem: Open-source capability lacks a verified problem owner, baseline and adoption boundary.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Demo day, hackathon and informal networking.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Public repository and synthetic or cleared fixtures only before authorization.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Manual process and written acceptance comparison.
scene_orders.human_gate: Problem owner decides whether to frame, test, refer or reject.
scene_orders.acceptance: A bounded test order is signed; demo interest alone is insufficient.
scene_orders.exit: Record rejection or no-fit with reusable reasoning; no automatic deployment.

scene_orders.problem: Everyday service issues are fragmented and residents cannot see responsibility or status.
scene_orders.current_fallback: 12345, community desk, property management, in-person discussion and borrow-return companion card.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Minimum issue fields and current-order token only; no continuous tracking, commercial profiling or cross-service identity graph.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Telephone, paper, borrow-return companion card and staffed desk retain equal access.
scene_orders.human_gate: Community or service operator accepts, refers or closes with a reason.
scene_orders.acceptance: A responsible channel and next step are visible to the resident.
scene_orders.exit: Remove aggregation if it adds delay, misroutes cases or encourages data overcollection.

scene_orders.problem: A model-service claim cannot be reproduced or compared across versions.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Human test plan, versioned fixtures and signed report.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Approved synthetic or cleared fixtures only; no live personal or service data.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Manual test execution and independent result review.
scene_orders.human_gate: Test owner signs scope, limitations, result and non-certification statement.
scene_orders.acceptance: The same approved fixtures produce traceable versioned results.
scene_orders.exit: Stop on irreproducibility, authorization breach or unsupported claim; no safety certification issued.

scene_orders.problem: A low-speed embodied system cannot demonstrate safe stop, yielding and human takeover.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Human-operated task in a controlled area.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Controlled test logs; no public biometric recognition or public-road tracking.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Human operation and physical exclusion zone.
scene_orders.human_gate: On-site safety officer has immediate stop and termination authority.
scene_orders.acceptance: Predefined stop, yield, takeover and incident drills pass in a controlled setting.
scene_orders.exit: Stop, remove device and preserve the human service if any safety or authorization gate fails.

scene_orders.title_zh: 端侧 AI 断网连续性
scene_orders.problem: A service cannot show what happens during network loss, cache expiry and recovery.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Paper SOP and staffed manual service.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Minimum local cache, documented retention and deletion; no hidden replication.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Paper or staffed process remains available during the full drill.
scene_orders.human_gate: Operator runs and signs outage, fallback, recovery and deletion checks.
scene_orders.acceptance: The service degrades safely, preserves the non-digital route and reconciles only authorized data.
scene_orders.exit: Do not pilot if fallback, recovery or deletion fails.

scene_orders.title_zh: AI 医疗、教育、法律边界说明
scene_orders.title_en: AI health, education and legal boundary desk
scene_orders.problem: People cannot distinguish low-risk assistance from decisions requiring a qualified professional.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Professional consultation, official service channel and staffed companion-card reminder.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Public explanation, window arrival and preparation checklist only; sensitive case data stays with authorized professionals.
scene_orders.human_gate: Qualified professional makes every diagnosis, admission or legal judgment; card reminders cannot substitute for the professional route.
scene_orders.acceptance: Users are correctly referred without an automated high-risk decision.
scene_orders.exit: Immediately remove any flow that implies diagnosis, eligibility or legal conclusion.

scene_orders.problem: Multilingual or generated heritage content may lose sources or distort history.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Public heritage sources only; no visitor tracking required.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Fixed attributed labels and human guide.
scene_orders.human_gate: Heritage and accessibility reviewers approve every published version.
scene_orders.acceptance: Claims link to sources and accessible Chinese/English versions remain aligned.
scene_orders.exit: Withdraw disputed or uncleared content while fixed verified information remains.

scene_orders.title_en: Why it did not proceed: closure exhibition
scene_orders.problem: Rejected, failed or retired pilots disappear, causing repeated cost and distrust.
scene_orders.current_fallback: Internal review and fragmented project files.
scene_orders.data_boundary: Aggregated and redacted closure reasons only; no personal or protected commercial information.
scene_orders.non_ai_baseline: Signed written closure note and physical notice.
scene_orders.human_gate: Problem owner and operator jointly approve disclosure and redaction.
scene_orders.acceptance: Adopted, referred, rejected and retired outcomes use the same visible structure.
scene_orders.exit: Do not publish if lawful redaction cannot protect people or confidential information.
